name: Ray-Cast Style Voxel Filling
definition: An algorithm to fill the interior of a mesh by scanning along the Z-axis, identifying intervals between front-facing and back-facing surface voxels and marking them as filled.
summary: Ray-Cast Style Voxel Filling determines interior mesh voxels by scanning along a principal axis and filling intervals between front and back faces, differing from stochastic methods by using deterministic scanline logic.
